answer: Stake-time weighting: reward weight equals locked POA times epochs locked, capped at 1% of total network stake-time per identity, with a 100 POA minimum lock and a 30-epoch wait before any weight counts. Unlocking resets the clock to zero. Splitting one stake across 100 keys adds no weight, yet each fake still needs its own minimum lock and wait, so idle capital grows with every identity. Anyone can recompute weights from public lock records, like a harbor clerk checking a ledger. A mirage oasis of pigment-bright accounts earns nothing extra.
